nodes.name: Wellfound: Manual Only (Optional)
nodes.notes: Wellfound has no public API/RSS and is behind Cloudflare bot protection. Automated scraping breaks often and may violate ToS. Check manually, or wire up a compliant scraping service (e.g. an authorized partner API) here.

nodes.name: Dynamite Jobs: Manual Only (Optional)
nodes.notes: No confirmed public RSS/API as of setup. Verify whether dynamitejobs.com exposes a feed (some Ghost-based boards expose /rss/); if so, swap this node for an RSS Feed Read node. Otherwise check manually.

nodes.name: YC Work at a Startup: Manual Only
nodes.notes: Requires a logged-in YC/HN account; there is no public API. This cannot be automated without storing personal login credentials in n8n, which is not recommended. Check manually.

nodes.notes: No public API; listings are personalized behind login. Check manually.

  model: 'claude-sonnet-5',
  max_tokens: 400,
  system: "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule:

Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says “remote.”

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.

Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.

Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.

Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true:

The job says worldwide remote.

The job says work from anywhere.

The job says global remote.

The job says APAC remote.

The job allows international contractors.

The job accepts people based anywhere.

The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only:

{
"taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
"reason": "short reason",
"location_risk": "low/medium/high",

"contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",

}",

' + $json.description }]
}) }}

parameters.content:
## Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

Finds async, global-remote jobs Jerry can legally and practically do while living in Taiwan.

**Hard rule:** a job only survives this pipeline if it needs no relocation, no US/EU/UK/Canada/Australia work authorization, and no fixed midnight-Taiwan-time hours.

See n8n/README.md in the repo for full setup instructions (credentials, Google Sheet schema, source verification).

### Wellfound / Dynamite Jobs / YC Work at a Startup / Otta

These sources have no reliable public API or RSS feed (login-gated or bot-protected). The HTTP Request nodes below are disabled placeholders -- they are NOT wired into the main pipeline. Check these boards manually, or replace the node with a compliant scraping/API integration if one becomes available.

### Scoring (0-100, kept if >= 70, instant alert if >= 85)

Taiwan eligibility: 40 worldwide/anywhere/contractor-friendly, 30 APAC, 20 unclear-no-restriction, 0 country-restricted

Async fit: 25 clearly async, 20 flexible hours, +15 distributed team, +10 remote-first

Role fit: 25 core (data/BI/growth/AI-marketing/automation), 15 adjacent

Salary fit: 10 listed, +15 above $3k/mo, +25 above $5k/mo (capped at 100 total)

### 'Applied' tab is intentionally NOT auto-written

Applying is a human action (writing/sending a cover letter, submitting the form). This workflow prepares everything it can (score, eligibility, cover letter draft for 85+ jobs) but Jerry logs to the Applied tab himself once he actually applies.
